items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: he would say, Lovey, I want you to come and help me with this. I'd say, all right. And he'd come over to my house and he'd stay there for hours and hours and hours.

ctx.x: And then if he had a piece that he'd write, he would say, Lovey, I want you to come and help me with this. I'd say, all right. And he'd come over to my house and he'd stay there for hours and hours and hours.
That's when you lived down near 31st Street down in there? 33rd. Third. 33rd.
